import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LocalizedModule.Submodule
import Mathlib.RingTheory.FiniteLength

/-!
# Finite length after localization

The submodule correspondence for localization embeds chains of submodules
of the localized module into chains in the original module.  This transfers
finite length from affine Cartier quotients to their stalks.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Localization preserves finite length, with scalars in the localized ring. -/
theorem IsFiniteLength.of_isLocalizedModule
    {R S M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] [Algebra R S] [Module S N]
    [IsScalarTower R S N]
    (p : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization p S]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule p f]
    (h : IsFiniteLength R M) : IsFiniteLength S N := by
  obtain ⟨hN, hA⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp h
  letI : IsArtinian R M := hA
  letI : WellFoundedGT (Submodule R M) := hN.wellFoundedGT
  apply isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr
  constructor
  · apply isNoetherian_mk
    exact (Submodule.localized'gi S p f).strictMono_u.dual.wellFoundedLT
  · exact (Submodule.localized'gi S p f).strictMono_u.wellFoundedLT
